title: Fruit soup
lead:
{{short description|Soup made primarily with fruit}}
[[File:Chinese fruit soup 3.jpg|thumb|Chinese fruit soup]]
[[File:Melonensuppe.JPG|thumb|[[Melon soup]]]]

'''Fruit soup''' is a [[soup]] prepared using [[fruit]] as a primary ingredient, and may be served warm or cold depending on the recipe. Some fruit soups use several varieties of fruit, and alcoholic beverages such as [[rum]], [[sherry]] and [[kirsch]] (a fruit brandy) may be used.<ref name="Harris 1993 p. 13"/>  Fruit soup is sometimes served as a dessert.<ref name="Harris 1993 p. 13"/>

Many recipes are for cold soups served when fruit is in season during warm weather.<ref name="Sethia Agarwal 2012 p. 38"/> Some, like [[Norway|Norwegian]] ''fruktsuppe'', may be served warm or cold, and rely on [[dried fruit]], such as dried [[prune]]s, [[apricot]]s<ref name="Munsen 2002 p. 55"/> and [[raisin]]s, thus being able to be prepared in any season. Fruit soups may include [[milk]]<ref name="Harris 1993 p. 13"/> or [[cream]], sweet or savoury [[dumpling]]s, [[spice]]s, or [[alcoholic beverage]]s, such as sweet wine, white wine,<ref name="Harris 1993 p. 13"/> brandy or champagne.
